name: THE PHOTOGRAPHER
note: Doc 07 #10: 'His studio. Sells stock portraits by the gross. Has the Mott photograph in his window.' Errata 183: he stands beside his camera in his studio off the Lane (Room 38), where the composition master stood him. His tree and his barks are doc 07's, extracted; doc 105's Overrides answer the room's wrong verbs. Present in every act.
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: beside him at the band's far edge, clear of him and of the card table (doc 55 section 8).

barks.R_RACCOON: I'll photograph the animal. I've done worse.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Portrait, Mr. Grubb! History, this is!
barks.R_WON_DUEL: Stand there. Chin up. There's a man.
barks.R_DEAD: …I've done post-mortems. I'd rather not, with you talking.
barks.R_TRUTH: Should I take Mr. Mott's likeness, do you think? A real one?

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the rest pose and its breath. Frame 2 is a stock portrait card tilted to the light, considered. Frame 3 is talking, a hand presenting. The sheet's card-held-up pose is not used: the raised arm closes a hole of air against his head, and a talking figure is drawn whole (tests/lessons.test.ts).
